definitions.always_neutral_baseline: signal-free comparator predicts neutral for every evaluated window, including detector-rejected/unarmed windows; same labels and denominators, pooled and per session; cued-trial candidate observations are zero for task detection and neutral false positives, retaining unavailable cue evidence as null rates; not a trained model, significance test, qualification or control policy
definitions.class_rejection: null predictions divided by windows of the actual class; includes unarmed and unusable windows; null rate when the class is absent
definitions.confusion: actual labels index rows; predicted_counts index predicted labels; rejected_windows is separate and includes every null prediction; raw counts retain absent classes as zeros; rows sum to actual_windows; pooled and per session; correlated windows are not independent trials
definitions.control_coverage: lists required artifact-control conditions with zero eligible exposure; an empty list does not establish adequate duration or qualification
definitions.dataset_excerpt_check: canonical-counter-adc-blocks-v1: scans every sample offset against 256-sample blocks of earlier manifest sessions; exact bytes confirm rolling-hash candidates; covers samples emitted by analysisWindows; no independence proof
definitions.detector_timing: nonnegative receipt times; overlapping or reordered windows within the current session/continuity are rejected and reset persistence; forward gaps over 0.05 seconds restart persistence
definitions.labels: participant/operator declarations, not independent physiological ground truth
definitions.latency: recorded cue completion to candidate input availability, not mental onset or live response
definitions.minimum_windows_per_class: caller-selected positive integer required for each profile class in full evaluation; counts all labeled windows including rejected inputs; not applied to controls-only evaluation; no physiological sufficiency claim
definitions.poisson_bound: one-sided 95% upper bound; assumes constant independent event rate; unavailable for carry-ins or zero eligible exposure
definitions.prediction: experimental candidate or explicit neutral; null is rejection, not neutral
definitions.reproduction: requires this manifest, the referenced original recordings and matching profile; verify both source digests
definitions.scored_trial: candidate persistence evidence must start within the scored interval and at or after the recorded cue; task success requires the target label, neutral false positive accepts any task candidate; missing cue yields null; carry-ins are not credited
definitions.session_conditions: exposure and onset counts by session and condition; pooled rates can hide between-session variability
definitions.session_resampling: optional exploratory whole-session pair resampling; not validated confidence coverage; assumes independent exchangeable sessions; few sessions, selection and missing exposure limit interpretation; never a qualification gate
definitions.time_axis: recorded receipt-time seconds; window end is the last sample receipt
definitions.training_source_audit: whole-content hash coverage of profile training sources among current manifest training sources; missing sources leave historical excerpt reuse unchecked; all present is not physiological or independence qualification
definitions.trial_association: optional conditional whole-trial schedule comparison; source-pinned recovered complete reviewed v1 plans, exact scored intervals and caller-selected exposure threshold; unavailable sessions carry no result; maximum-run-three balanced assignments only; exchangeability, neural origin and physiological validity remain unverified
definitions.trial_eligible_fraction: armed usable window duration divided by the declared scored interval; includes gaps in denominator; not confidence or physiological validity
definitions.trial_metrics: cued task target observations or cued neutral false positives; one observation per declared trial; missing cues counted unavailable; zero eligible exposure retained; controls reported separately; no confidence or independence claim

limitations: Correlated windows are not independent trials.
Control-only results do not measure task recall.
No physiological accuracy or safe system control is established.
Hashes detect changes; they do not authenticate authorship.
Source files are read as streams, not locked immutable snapshots.

Profile hashes detect complete training-recording reuse; excerpt checks compare only source sessions present in this manifest. Short or transformed excerpts and absent historical training sources are not excluded.
Parent lineage does not audit historical model-selection or evaluation reuse.
